text:
linda: Pen test team just uploaded the report and requested a retest window next week. They flagged 4 auth-related findings and want an evidence handoff for logs + KMS-wrapped keys. Who owns the RBAC changes and the evidence snapshot?

maria_secops: I can lead triage. Plan: 1) Triage & severity assign in vuln tracker 2) Create timeboxed ephemeral roles for assessors 3) Provide presigned evidence bucket + KMS-wrapped key for secrets.

aj_infra: Quick q — do they need kms:Decrypt or just GenerateDataKey/Decrypt on the evidence key? We should limit to GenerateDataKey and encrypt artifacts server-side then give them only the encrypted blob.

linda: Good call. Prefer minimal decrypt surface. Maria — can you confirm we can avoid handing plaintext? Also need audit log retention for the retest window.

maria_secops: Yes — prefer encrypted-blobs. We'll provide a signed envelope (DataKey ciphertext) and a manifest. Audit logging: enable S3 access logging + CloudTrail for KMS -> set retention to 90 days for the retest evidence.

tom_runtime: Heads up: some of the artifacts include model inference logs and embedding indices — those are large. We'll need a snapshot script that strips PII and throttles export. I'll paste the script snippet we use:
```bash
# sanitize-and-upload.sh
python tools/sanitize_logs.py --input /var/log/runner --strip-ids --out /tmp/sanitized.tar.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/sanitized.tar.gz s3://pt-evidence-uploads/${ASSESSOR_SESSION}/ --acl private --storage-class STANDARD
```

maria_secops: thanks Tom. Add a SHA256 manifest and sign it with the ops key so the assessor can verify integrity. We will then Encrypt the file with KMS CMK (key alias/pt-evidence) and hand them the ciphertext + manifest.

pen-test-bot: Automated: external-assessment uploaded report (id: rpt-2026-03-21-88). Requested retest window: 2026-03-28 to 2026-04-01. Assessor: @AcmeSec.

sarah_prodsec: Are we ok with the retest window length? Also need a rollback plan if a fix breaks traffic — propose canary deploy + feature flag hold.

aj_infra: For ephemeral access I'd like to use short-lived AWS STS AssumeRole with external ID. Steps I suggest: 1) Create an IAM role: PTAssessorRole with minimal S3 + KMS decrypt? (prefer no decrypt) 2) Bind role to external principal with ExternalId 3) Issue session tokens limited to retest dates. Example CLI to create role trust (quick):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/AcmeSec"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "pt-2026-03-28"}}
  }]
}
```

maria_secops: We'll avoid giving KMS:Decrypt. Assessor gets encrypted blobs + envelope keys. If they need plaintext for verification, they'll request it and we'll do a timeboxed decrypt session with two-person approval.

linda: Ok owners: Maria -> triage + issuance of ephemeral role, Aj -> IAM trust document + ExternalId workflow, Tom -> sanitize & produce artifact, Sarah -> rollout/rollback plan. Can everyone confirm ETA for readiness?

maria_secops: I'll have vuln tracker entries + presigned bucket + manifest ready by 2026-03-25 EOD.

aj_infra: IAM role + ExternalId provisioning done by 2026-03-24 noon. I'll post the assume-role instructions and expiration policies.

tom_runtime: Sanitization run + upload test by 2026-03-25 morning. Will attach sample manifest.

sarah_prodsec: I'll draft the canary rollback playbook and QA checklist by 2026-03-25 EOD.

linda: Great. Final check — do we need a short dry-run with the assessor before the official retest? Suggest a 1-hour handshake session on 2026-03-26 to validate artifact access and audit logs.

maria_secops: +1 to dry-run. I'll schedule the 1-hr session and include steps to verify CloudTrail events (KMS:Encrypt/GenerateDataKey, S3:GetObject). Will also record acceptance steps.

aj_infra: I'll provide a quick command to verify the STS token and ExternalId flow during the dry-run.

linda: Thanks team. I'll summarize plan in the vuln tracker and add the retest slot. :thumbsup:
